title: A EYE GLITCH
overview: A 16 year-old girl's world unravels when she begins recalling vivid memories of a past life as a Black woman, a mother, a dreamer, a soul cut short before her time. As she pieces together the fragments of who she once was, she crosses paths with a young man whose presence feels like Déjà vu. What begins as a strange connection turns into a soul deep recognition. This young man is her son from another lifetime. Bound by memories and separated by fate, they must both confront the meaning of love, identity, and the invisible thread that binds her life to her new found reality.
